title: File:Pete Hegseth Swearing-In.jpg
desc: It was my honor to play a part in Pete Hegseth’s confirmation as Secretary of Defense. Pete has dedicated his life to serving his country and will continue to do so at the Pentagon. I look forward to seeing him succeed in his new role.
